verdict.rationale: Blaxel documents Jobs that run many AI tasks in parallel as batch work, scheduled or on demand, on auto-scaling serverless infrastructure. Its agent skill also lets an AI agent launch these batch jobs from prompts. That covers bulk processing of many work items, but nothing shows bulk management actions across many platform resources at once. missing for 10: bulk management of resources (e.g., multi-sandbox delete/update/archive in one call), details on how batch inputs fan out across items, independent or hands-on corroboration.
